topic: Kubernetes pod lifecycle and debugging commands
linkedin_hook: Master Kubernetes pod management with these essential lifecycle and debugging commands!
linkedin_intro: As a DevOps engineer, I've often found myself needing to quickly reference Kubernetes commands to manage and debug pods. This cheatsheet is my go-to resource for streamlining pod lifecycle management and troubleshooting. I've compiled the most useful commands into one place to help you work more efficiently.

pro_tips: Use 'kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount}'' to get the restart count of the first container in the first pod
Use 'kubectl rollout restart deployment/<deployment_name>' to restart all pods in a deployment
Use 'kubectl top pod/<pod_name> --containers' to display resource usage of all containers in a pod
Use 'kubectl alpha debug <pod_name> --image=<debug_image> --target=<container_name>' to debug a specific container in a pod
